1. Introduction
3
Diffraction plays an important role in spatial distribution of laser energyAfter multiple traveling, a steady-state field will be formed: energydistribution will not be influenced by diffraction any more; the field oflight is the same as the field before previous reflectionThe shape of the field is the sameThe amplitude is differentThe phase is differenceBabinet's Principle: In physics, Babinet's principle is a theoremconcerning diffraction. It mentions that the diffraction pattern from anopaque body is identical to that from a hole of the same size and shapeexcept for the overall forward beam intensity.
